directive.quote: reuse ported original helpers through currentrecords-door seam, with honest source baseline(s), preserve currentAPI; thinadapter qualifies narrowly distinct only whenactuallydelegating.

preserve: Keep current hearARecording, hearALink, hearFile, fetcherProgram, linkSettings and public parser/fetcher exports and result shapes.
Read the recording by name through the host (host.readWholeFile, the run's files right) into the run folder, and hear it with the existing audio_transcription.py seam.
Keep caption preference, explanatory refusals, current model selection, owned temporary cleanup and the removal of the recording copy.
allowed_deltas: Move embedded caption, process-running and link-flow code behind imports of the actively called original-source recovery helpers; those helpers have separate exact source-copy contracts.
This is an in-place adaptation of the existing current protocol bridge. It does not claim the whole old listener was copied into this file.

Restore reader eligibility and fallback by calling the public computer-programs hearingHere owner; bind an explicit reader through that same owner and reject substitution for an explicitly named path.
Allow the existing dependency-options argument to supply settings for controlled consumer tests; runtime tool input and result schemas stay unchanged.
banned_substitutions: A second caption parser, fetcher or link-control-flow implementation inside the protocol bridge
A historical raw-copy claim for the pre-recovery hearing adapter
An import of the retired account runtime or a fake origin/key to satisfy the old transport

proof.recovery_state: Private in-place adaptation of the existing current bridge; named recovery commit holds its unchanged source bytes. Current API delegates to the actively used recovered helpers and existing program/transcription owners and the run host.
